regime_context: The CSI 300 thematic rotation is led by Semiconductors (score 0.877) but with extremely narrow breadth (0.045) and moderate durability (0.47). The absolute-trend gate historically failed to reduce drawdown in this market (gate_helps=false), making eligibility a display signal rather than a validated edge. Non-leader Food & Beverage shows high durability (0.83), broad participation (0.90), and no crowding, while rotation breadth is narrow (27% of themes eligible). Given the gate's ineffectiveness and a poor local track record (direction accuracy 0.375), any lean must be treated as a low-confidence conditional hypothesis.
emerging_watch: Semiconductors (cn_semis): The extreme breadth weakness (0.045) suggests the leader's trend is fragile. Watch for a durability breakdown below 0.40 or a rank decline to 3rd or lower as early signs of narrative unwinding. Kill this watch if breadth improves above 0.20 and durability holds above 0.40 for five consecutive trading days.
